extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone. The server serves one surface profile per launch, selected by the --profile argument: profiles lists one invocation entry per declared profile, and the bare invocation (no argument) launches defaultProfile.

profiles.description: Default. The standing operator surface: record listing/status plus the tier-checked delivery export.
Core plus intake: register works, validate ingest, and screen works before extraction.
Core plus image work: scene segmentation, face extraction, and dialogue extraction.
Core plus acts: act extraction, scene understanding, and record enrichment.
Core plus voice: voice analysis, clonability assessment, voice derivation, and torori cue emission.
Every tool: core plus all four packs.

description: NTRanch's media-extraction MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28): screened works in, faces, dialogue, acts, and torori voice cues out, for the clean-room rebuild programme. Launch profiles scope the served catalog per process: core by default, the acts, image, intake, and voice packs composable, full for everything. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Neemu does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Neemu

skills.description: Register a work, validate its ingest, and screen it before any extraction (neemu_register_work, neemu_validate_ingest, neemu_screen_work).
skills.name: Intake and screening

skills.description: Segment scenes and extract faces and dialogue from screened media (neemu_segment_scene, neemu_extract_faces, neemu_extract_dialogue).
skills.name: Scenes, faces, and dialogue

skills.description: Extract acts, understand scene structure, and enrich the record (neemu_extract_acts, neemu_understand_scene, neemu_enrich).
skills.name: Acts and enrichment

skills.description: Analyse voices, assess clonability, derive voice profiles, and emit torori voice cues (neemu_analyze_voice, neemu_assess_voice_clonability, neemu_derive_voice, neemu_emit_torori_cue).
skills.name: Voice cues for torori

skills.description: List records and export tier-checked deliveries (neemu_list_records, neemu_export) - the standing operator surface served by every profile.
skills.name: Records and export
